findings.issue: Add-Member -NotePropertyName $projectKey sits outside the try. When a projects entry has an empty-string key and hasTrustDialogAccepted:true, Add-Member throws 'Cannot process argument because the value of argument "name" is not valid'. That is a terminating error under EAP=Stop, and it goes through Test-ClaudeTeamAccount into the launcher and Step21. An empty key also sends PS 7 to the fallback, because the default ConvertFrom-Json rejects empty property names. I reproduced this on both the PS 7 (-AsHashtable) path and the simulated 5.1 (JavaScriptSerializer) path. claude never writes an empty project key, so the input is implausible, but it contradicts the report's claim that the check 'never ends with a terminating error'.
findings.fix: Skip empty keys in the loop (-not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($projectKey)), or build the trusted set inside the existing try so any failure returns $null (WARN plus 'missing').
